ITEM 1 | Roasted potato wedges, pale golden-yellow flesh with browned, crisp-looking edges and darker caramelized patches on the skin side; matte to lightly glossy surface, firm and holding shape; roughly 7 irregular wedge/chunk pieces each about 3-4 cm long and 2 cm thick, clustered in the right-center of the plate and covering about 30% of the plate surface | 150

ITEM 2 | Small light-brown seasoning specks scattered over the potato pieces, dry and granular, sitting on top of the potato surfaces | 1

ITEM 3 | Plain white square-ish plate with no visible sauce, oil pooling, or liquid around the food; the plate is about 26 cm across and the food sits on its right half | 0
